name: application-candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: An OHLC financial chart — open/high/low/close candles with up/down coloring — paired with a matching volume strip below the price axis.
useWhen: Displaying price history for a tradable asset where the open/high/low/close range per period matters, not just the closing value.
Volume alongside price helps explain conviction behind a price move (e.g. a breakout on high volume vs. low volume drift).
avoidWhen: You only need the closing trend over time — a simple line chart from `charts` is lighter-weight and easier to read at a glance.
The data isn't time-series OHLC data — this component's visual language specifically implies open/high/low/close semantics.
responsiveBehavior: The chart is a single SVG with viewBox scaling; candle and volume-bar widths scale proportionally with the container, so it stays legible down to roughly 320px wide before candles become too thin to read.
accessibility: Up/down movement is conveyed by both color (green/red) and candle position (body above or below the open line) so the direction isn't color-only.
The header states the exact closing price and percentage change as text, not solely inferred from the chart shape.
Provide a text or table alternative (date, open, high, low, close, volume) for screen reader users, since the SVG candles are not independently announced.

variants.title: Price and volume
variants.description: A 24-period OHLC candlestick chart with a matching volume strip below, header showing the ticker, exchange, closing price, and percentage change.
accessibility: The percentage change is colored to match its sign (green for positive, red for negative) and prefixed with a '+' or implicit '-' as text.

variants.title: Price and volume (Dark)
variants.description: Candlestick and volume chart adapted for dark surfaces, with up/down colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Candle and volume-bar colors meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
